summary: Reproduced the seeded min-p assertion on the prepared base and assigned gfx950 GPU, removed the unsupported assertion, and verified deterministic filtered sampling, original-token remapping, normalization invariance, and threshold/top-k boundaries. A matching open upstream candidate exists at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33699 but is not in the prepared base.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction of the exact reported AssertionError in the checked-out implementation on gfx950.
Failing-before regression: all three seeded min-p tests reached the reported assertion before the source correction; the test was later moved to unit/layers.
Three passing-after GPU cases covering deterministic replay and vocabulary-ID mapping, equality with independently normalized filtered weights, and inclusive min-p threshold combined with top-k.
On AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950, two identical calls matched; 128 samples selected only retained original token IDs (76 ID 1, 52 ID 3), with filtered IDs absent.
All applicable repository formatting, lint, syntax, spelling, and CI-registration checks passed.
Focused tests passed, but server-backed neighboring tests were blocked by HTTP 401 for gated meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct weights; 11 passed, 4 skipped, 17 setup errors.

gpu_evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950/capability (9, 5), ROCm 7.2, torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; deterministic=True and only retained original vocabulary IDs were sampled.
remaining_limitations: No full-model or HTTP serving-path validation is claimed; the available neighboring server test required gated Llama weights and failed with HTTP 401 before startup.
Validation used one assigned gfx950 GPU only; no multi-GPU or multi-node workload was exercised.
No native code changed, so native rebuild validation was not applicable.
